items.title: Awesome Blazor
items.content_text:
### Games

*   [TabletopCardEngine demo (⭐1)](https://github.com/DigitalAbsurd/TabletopCardEngine) - ![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/DigitalAbsurd/TabletopCardEngine?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=604800) ![last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/DigitalAbsurd/TabletopCardEngine?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=86400) Texas Hold'em played and replayed in Blazor WebAssembly, with a live view of the database rows each action writes. [Demo](https://digitalabsurd.github.io/TabletopCardEngine/).

### Component bundles

*   [Radzen.Blazor (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/radzenhq/radzen-blazor) - ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/radzenhq/radzen-blazor?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=604800) ![last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/radzenhq/radzen-blazor?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=86400) Free and open-source (MIT, including commercial use) library of 155+ native Blazor components: DataGrid, Scheduler, Gantt, PivotDataGrid, Spreadsheet with XLSX import/export, 30+ chart types, HtmlEditor and more, with Material, Standard, Default, Humanistic and Software themes in light and dark. ([Demos](https://blazor.radzen.com/)).

### Routing & Navigation / Modal, Toast & Notifications

*   [Routeables (⭐0)](https://github.com/cedric56/Routeables) - ![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/cedric56/Routeables?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=604800) ![last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/cedric56/Routeables?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=86400) Route-based MVVM navigation for Blazor (Server, WebAssembly and MAUI Hybrid): view models declare routes (`[Routeable("/dogs/{name}")]`) and navigate through a single `IRouter`, with typed route methods, regions and navigation guards. The same view models also run on MAUI, Avalonia, Uno and WPF. [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Routeables.Razor).

### Routing & Navigation / Others

*   [WebFilez (⭐0)](https://github.com/gordon-matt/WebFilez) - ![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/gordon-matt/WebFilez?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=604800) ![last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/gordon-matt/WebFilez?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=86400) Open source file manager for web written in Blazor. Demos available for Blazor, MVC and React.

### Articles / Others

*   [Announcing .NET 11](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/dotnet/announcing-dotnet-11/) - November 10, 2026 - .NET 11 is here with C# 15, faster developer tools, runtime and library improvements, and new capabilities for web, mobile, desktop, and AI apps.
*   [Get Ready for .NET Conf 2026!](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/dotnet/get-ready-for-dotnet-conf-2026/) - November 3, 2026 - Join Microsoft November 10-13 for this free, four-day virtual conference and the official launch of .NET 11. We’ll kick things off with two days of sessions from Microsoft product teams, followed by two days of community-led talks from developers around the world.

items.content_text:
### Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

*   [Noteriv](https://www.noteriv.com/) - Open-source Markdown note-taking app with wiki-links, graph view, plugins, Git/WebDAV sync and a built-in MCP server for AI assistants. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/thejacedev/Noteriv) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### AI Tools / Other Tools

*   [MoMo Agent (⭐15)](https://github.com/Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent) - Open-source, self-hosted 24/7 personal agent for Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac with on-device CoreML ASR, embedded Tailscale, and an Obsidian-style Markdown memory vault. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [VoiceStudio](https://saadmsft.github.io/VoiceStudio/) - Real-time broadcast voice rack in Swift and CoreAudio with subtle pitch depth, sub-harmonic warmth, 6-band EQ, de-esser, and compressor for Discord, Zoom, Teams, and OBS. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/saadmsft/VoiceStudio) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Proxy and VPN Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [LockPlus (⭐15)](https://github.com/steiale/lockplus) - WireGuard and OpenVPN client with a kill switch that macOS itself enforces. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/steiale/lockplus) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

*   [TocaPad (⭐1)](https://github.com/getguruhat/tocapad-macos) - Slide your trackpad's edges to change volume and brightness, and double-tap a corner to run a shortcut. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/getguruhat/tocapad-macos) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / General Tools

*   [Yado](https://yado.house/) - Native Mac app for managing an iPhone: clear duplicate photos, large videos and unused apps, arrange the Home Screen, move files and keep backups on the Mac. ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Productivity

*   [LinkUnbound](https://www.linkunbound.app/) - Open-source browser picker that asks which browser or browser profile should open each link, with rules by site or by the app the link came from. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/rgdevment/LinkUnbound) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

*   [PC Mode (⭐2)](https://github.com/getguruhat/PCMode) - Free app that brings Windows habits to your Mac: delete from Finder with the Delete key, cut and move files with ⌘X and ⌘V, and switch individual windows with ⌘Tab. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/getguruhat/PCMode) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

items.title: Awesome Ai in Finance
items.content_text:
### Agents

*   [FastTrade AI (⭐1)](https://github.com/kingabzpro/FastTrade-AI) - Signal-only LLM market research workspace with deterministic risk checks, a budgeted batch API, and reproducible checksummed backtests. Never places orders.
*   [oracle3 (⭐569)](https://github.com/YichengYang-Ethan/oracle3-prediction-market-agent) - Prediction-market trading engine and MCP server for Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana, with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related contracts and live or paper execution.
*   [DXAP](https://www.dxap.ai/) - Agentic trading harness on Hyperliquid by DX Research Group: write a strategy in plain language, an AI agent trades your own account inside limits a policy engine enforces, and every decision is logged.
*   [seduma-trade-agent-demo (⭐0)](https://github.com/Quantum-Karate/seduma-trade-agent-demo) - Practice-only loop that runs LLM trading-agent decisions through confirm-gated simulated fills.
*   [LLM\_trader (⭐141)](https://github.com/qrak/LLM_trader) - An LLM trading agent that reads a chart rendered from every closed candle, retrieves its own closed trades as memory, and publishes every prompt, decision and loss; paper trading with a ledger the repo can reproduce.
*   [TRA (bitra) (⭐47)](https://github.com/BijectiveLabs/bitra) - Autonomous crypto trading system in which LLM agents only propose: deterministic rules compute every figure, price costs before any order, size from the operator's risk limit, keep exits at the exchange, and record every decision with a re-verifiable hash.
*   [AlphaFinch (⭐2)](https://github.com/shloksobti/alphafinch) - AlphaEvolve-style agent that invents and evolves trading strategies as code, then grades them on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam; no brokerage connection.
*   [multi-agent-investment (⭐0)](https://github.com/lss680455-create/multi-agent-investment) - Multi-agent equity research with three reasoning modes and deterministic signal fusion; decisions are reproducible from a pure-function core, with an offline demo that needs no API keys.
*   [FriesTrader (⭐307)](https://github.com/YizhiSong/FriesTrader) - Claude Code template for automated live orders through Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP, with rule-based position sizing and trade limits. Requires an eligible Robinhood Agentic Trading account.

### Skills

*   [Krexa (⭐119)](https://github.com/Krexa-xyz/skills) - Agent skill and remote MCP server for turning a trading idea, post or video into fixed rules, backtesting and paper-trading them free, and requesting a user-approved live trading agent on Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, MEXC, Hyperliquid, Polymarket and Solana DEXs.
*   [SmartMoney-Cub (⭐26)](https://github.com/myc0576/SmartMoney-Cub) - Read-only trading journal and review harness for agents: freezes point-in-time evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and grades rule candidates on a frozen 240-case finance benchmark. MIT.

### Market Data

*   [itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp (⭐0)](https://github.com/itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp) - Open-source MCP server for official EU open data: ECB FX rates, policy rates and HICP inflation, EU consolidated sanctions screening, VIES VAT validation, and GLEIF LEI ownership chains. No API key for these tools; same tools also available as pay-per-use Apify actors.

### Research & Analysis

*   [firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server (⭐7.8k)](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server) - **Official** Firecrawl MCP server for finance research agents: web search, scrape, and crawl, plus Alexandria providers for SEC EDGAR filings and FRED macro series. Alexandria requires an API key.
*   [Kernel-Hunter/kandle (⭐9)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/kandle) - Open-source browser charting app with an MCP server: agents read the chart, draw levels, add indicators and alerts, and run strategy backtests on crypto, stocks and forex.
*   [signal8ai/signal8-mcp (⭐1)](https://github.com/signal8ai/signal8-mcp) - **Official** Signal8 MCP server: small-cap dilution (warrants, ATMs, shelf registrations, convertibles, cash runway) with each figure cited to its SEC filing, plus insider and congressional trades, halts and reverse splits. Requires a Signal8 Pro API key.
*   [Beltran12138/evidence-deflator (⭐0)](https://github.com/Beltran12138/evidence-deflator) - Open-source MCP server and Python library that checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs after selection; publishes an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
*   [financial-reports/financial-reports-mcp-server (⭐2)](https://github.com/financial-reports/financial-reports-mcp-server) - **Official** FinancialFilings MCP server: annual and interim reports, ad-hoc disclosures and ESEF/XBRL filings from securities regulators in about 60 markets, with XBRL financials and company identifiers. Free with a registered account (OAuth).
*   [kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules (⭐1)](https://github.com/kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules) - Prop-firm risk rules MCP server (FTMO, Topstep, Apex and more): sourced daily-loss and max-drawdown limits plus a drawdown-room check for trading agents. Stdio or free hosted endpoint, no API key.

### Papers

*   [Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital, 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26091) - 21-day deployment of 3,505 user-funded LLM agents trading real ETH on Base, measuring how controls outside the model change agent behavior.
*   [What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets, 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05663) - Six months of production behavior from two LLM trading fleets, DX Terminal Pro and DXAP, with paper artifacts and aggregate data on [GitHub (⭐51)](https://github.com/ProjectDXAI/continuous-record-llm-trading-agents).

### Courses & Books & Blogs

*   [Agents Finance](https://agentsfinance.io/) - Free bilingual (EN/ES) directory of real AI-agent use cases in accounting, FP\&A, treasury and ERPs, with sources, evidence level and copyable prompts.
*   [EcoFinLearn](https://ecofinlearning.com) - Free in-browser Python, pandas, scikit-learn and SQL lessons for finance and economics students, including return prediction with scikit-learn; runs on Pyodide and SQLite with no signup.

### Time Series Data

*   [PredixLab Signals (⭐0)](https://github.com/predixlab/predixlab-signals) - Python research pipeline for daily US equity signals (S\&P 500 / Nasdaq-100): LightGBM with purged walk-forward validation, next-session backtests with per-side costs, and leakage tests. Daily data only; not live quotes.

### Portfolio Management

*   [CAST (⭐3)](https://github.com/FanBroWell/CAST) - Cross-asset Kalman filtering with model predictive control for limiting portfolio drawdown (ICDM 2026).

### Data Sources / Traditional Markets

*   [autorekt (⭐5)](https://github.com/autorekt/autorekt) - CLI and agent skill that give AI agents market data from free public sources: cross-asset prices, dollar liquidity, swap spreads, positioning, options gamma, China money markets and prediction-market odds, with the age of every value.
*   [US Bank Data (⭐1)](https://github.com/anshuman-pandey/us-bank-data) - Open Python package for selected FDIC institution financial snapshots and multi-bank quarterly panels with explicit units and archived source evidence.

### Data Sources / Crypto Currencies

*   [TokenSonar](https://tokensonar.com/data/) - Institutional adoption scores (0-100) for cryptocurrencies built from spot-ETF assets, institutional partners, news and on-chain real-world-asset value; free JSON download with published methodology, updated twice daily.

### Data Sources / Prediction Markets

*   [Resolved Markets](https://resolvedmarkets.com) - Historical Polymarket order book snapshots, trades and resolutions via REST, WebSocket and a hosted MCP server, plus Hyperliquid perp books. Free tier covers crypto markets.

### Research Tools / Prediction Markets

*   [tracemodel (⭐8)](https://github.com/datayoga-io/tracemodel) - Python library for financial models that AI agents fill from filings: every number has a source, formulas are traced, and checks catch totals that do not tie.
*   [StockTipsArena](https://stocktipsarena.com) - AI-extracted Indian equity (NSE) analyst recommendation tracker, SEBI registry directory, and stock screener auditing 27,000+ public calls against exchange OHLCV candles, with an open CC BY 4.0 benchmark dataset ([GitHub (⭐0)](https://github.com/StockTipsArena/india-analyst-accuracy-benchmark)) and MCP server ([GitHub (⭐0)](https://github.com/StockTipsArena/stocktipsarena-mcp)). Free tier available.
*   [FinTwin (⭐4)](https://github.com/SpiliosDimakopoulos/fintwin) - Open source digital twin of 390+ public companies' finances built from SEC XBRL filings, with Monte Carlo stress tests, conformal forecast intervals and an out-of-sample backtest on 5,000+ SEC filers. Live dashboard and paper included.
*   [wallstreetype-research (⭐2)](https://github.com/lss680455-create/wallstreetype-research) - Agent-agnostic equity-research pipeline that turns sell-side report methodology into runnable code: a dual-market data layer (US / A-share), institutional chart families, six layout templates, and Markdown-to-Word/PDF report production.

### Traditional Market / Prediction Markets

*   [lumibot (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/Lumiwealth/lumibot) - Python framework for backtesting and live trading with the same strategy code, with a built-in AI agent runtime and 12 broker integrations across stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto and prediction markets.

### GYM Environment / Plugins

*   [tradefloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/simoncoombes/tradefloor) - Simulated stock markets with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, for testing RL policies and LLM trading agents, with a Gymnasium environment and adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI and LangGraph.

  • kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules (⭐1) - Prop-firm risk rules MCP server (FTMO, Topstep, Apex and more): sourced daily-loss and max-drawdown limits plus a drawdown-room check for trading agents. Stdio or free hosted endpoint, no API key.

Papers

  • Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital, 2026 - 21-day deployment of 3,505 user-funded LLM agents trading real ETH on Base, measuring how controls outside the model change agent behavior.
  • What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets, 2026 - Six months of production behavior from two LLM trading fleets, DX Terminal Pro and DXAP, with paper artifacts and aggregate data on GitHub (⭐51).

Courses & Books & Blogs

  • Agents Finance - Free bilingual (EN/ES) directory of real AI-agent use cases in accounting, FP&A, treasury and ERPs, with sources, evidence level and copyable prompts.
  • EcoFinLearn - Free in-browser Python, pandas, scikit-learn and SQL lessons for finance and economics students, including return prediction with scikit-learn; runs on Pyodide and SQLite with no signup.

Time Series Data

  • PredixLab Signals (⭐0) - Python research pipeline for daily US equity signals (S&P 500 / Nasdaq-100): LightGBM with purged walk-forward validation, next-session backtests with per-side costs, and leakage tests. Daily data only; not live quotes.

Portfolio Management

  • CAST (⭐3) - Cross-asset Kalman filtering with model predictive control for limiting portfolio drawdown (ICDM 2026).

Data Sources / Traditional Markets

  • autorekt (⭐5) - CLI and agent skill that give AI agents market data from free public sources: cross-asset prices, dollar liquidity, swap spreads, positioning, options gamma, China money markets and prediction-market odds, with the age of every value.
  • US Bank Data (⭐1) - Open Python package for selected FDIC institution financial snapshots and multi-bank quarterly panels with explicit units and archived source evidence.

Data Sources / Crypto Currencies

  • TokenSonar - Institutional adoption scores (0-100) for cryptocurrencies built from spot-ETF assets, institutional partners, news and on-chain real-world-asset value; free JSON download with published methodology, updated twice daily.

Data Sources / Prediction Markets

  • Resolved Markets - Historical Polymarket order book snapshots, trades and resolutions via REST, WebSocket and a hosted MCP server, plus Hyperliquid perp books. Free tier covers crypto markets.

Research Tools / Prediction Markets

  • tracemodel (⭐8) - Python library for financial models that AI agents fill from filings: every number has a source, formulas are traced, and checks catch totals that do not tie.
  • StockTipsArena - AI-extracted Indian equity (NSE) analyst recommendation tracker, SEBI registry directory, and stock screener auditing 27,000+ public calls against exchange OHLCV candles, with an open CC BY 4.0 benchmark dataset (GitHub (⭐0)) and MCP server (GitHub (⭐0)). Free tier available.
  • FinTwin (⭐4) - Open source digital twin of 390+ public companies' finances built from SEC XBRL filings, with Monte Carlo stress tests, conformal forecast intervals and an out-of-sample backtest on 5,000+ SEC filers. Live dashboard and paper included.
  • wallstreetype-research (⭐2) - Agent-agnostic equity-research pipeline that turns sell-side report methodology into runnable code: a dual-market data layer (US / A-share), institutional chart families, six layout templates, and Markdown-to-Word/PDF report production.

Traditional Market / Prediction Markets

  • lumibot (⭐2.2k) - Python framework for backtesting and live trading with the same strategy code, with a built-in AI agent runtime and 12 broker integrations across stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto and prediction markets.

GYM Environment / Plugins

  • tradefloor (⭐0) - Simulated stock markets with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, for testing RL policies and LLM trading agents, with a Gymnasium environment and adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI and LangGraph.

items.title: Awesome Open Source Games
items.content_text:
### Browser-Based / Boardgame

*   [Daily Word Hunt (⭐1)](https://github.com/s87343472/daily-word-hunt) - Free browser daily word search (find-the-word). New puzzle every day, themed series, print packs.
*   [Chessmata (⭐20)](https://github.com/metavert-io/chessmata) - Open-source multiplayer chess platform for humans and AI agents, with real-time WebSocket gameplay, Elo-based matchmaking, 3D browser board (Three.js), MCP server, and UCI-compatible CLI. Built with Go and React.

### Browser-Based / Arcade

*   [Trick or Take (⭐0)](https://github.com/zicojiao/trick-or-take) - Multiplayer Halloween party web game built with vanilla Canvas 2D, Agora RTC voice chat, and Cloudflare Workers edge.
*   [Wave Rider Nusantara (⭐6)](https://github.com/abusofianid/game-wave-rider-nusantara) - Arcade game inspired by Indonesian culture, featuring the legendary character Gatot Kaca and traditional Batik patterns. Built with React and JavaScript.

### Browser-Based / Sandbox

*   [Cubyz (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/PixelGuys/Cubyz) - Open voxel simulation game in active development with building, crafting and survival mechanics. Licensed under GPL3.

### Browser-Based / Geography

*   [World Chase (⭐0)](https://github.com/JezKirkpatrick/WorldChase) - Competitive weekly geography game. Decode cryptic riddles to find real-world locations on a map. Global leaderboard, VS duels, 25 new challenges every week.
*   [Kids World Chase (⭐0)](https://github.com/JezKirkpatrick/kids-world-chase) - Weekly geography adventure for children aged 8-13. Solve riddles, explore real locations via Google Street View.
